supported_scope: Producing a developer-reviewable implementation plan before changing code, including interactive review and approval of the plan artifact
unestablished_scope: Whether planning is strictly required before any code changes
Whether approval gates are mandatory or optional by policy
required_setup: Invoke the CLI in plan mode (agy --mode=plan) or prepend /plan instruction prefix to prompts; optionally configure artifact review policies for plan approval behavior
constraints: Plan mode uses read-only tools to analyze codebase before writing
User must review and approve the structured Implementation Plan artifact before proceeding
Default mode pauses for interactive diff review before applying file writes
Artifact review policies can configure whether the agent pauses for plan approval

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Analyze tasks before editing with plan mode
evidence.quote: When plan mode is active through Shift+Tab cycling or the --mode flag, the CLI automatically prepends the /plan instruction prefix to your prompts. The agent investigates relevant files using read-only tools ( code_search , grep_search , view_file ) and presents a structured execution outline for your approval before writing code.
evidence.claim: Plan mode enables producing a structured execution outline for user approval before code changes.

evidence.quote: When you invoke /plan , Antigravity runs a multi-phase planning and discovery workflow designed to produce an actionable implementation plan: Analysis and discovery ... Clarification and interviewing ... Structured plan creation ... User review and approval : The agent presents the plan artifact in the review pane. You can review the proposed steps, leave inline annotations, or adjust individual t
evidence.claim: /plan command produces a reviewable implementation plan with user approval before execution.

evidence.quote: Artifact review policies : Configure whether the agent pauses for plan approval using your project’s artifact review policy . Proceed : Click Proceed to transition the agent into execution mode. The agent follows the approved plan step-by-step, validating each milestone with tests.
evidence.claim: User can configure artifact review policies to require plan approval before proceeding to implementation.

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Review modifications in default mode
evidence.quote: In default mode ( request-review ), Antigravity CLI pauses before applying any file writes to disk and renders an inline, syntax-highlighted diff preview.
evidence.claim: Default mode pauses for interactive review of code changes before applying them.
